payoff.title: Hypothetical example · at expiry
payoff.terms: Strike $100 · premium $5 per share · before fees and taxes
payoff.chartTitle: Payoff of buying a call or a put
payoff.chartDesc: The call loses $5 if the price ends at $100 or below, breaks even at $105 and makes $15 at $120. The put makes $15 at $80, breaks even at $95 and loses $5 at $100 or above. Amounts per share.
payoff.formula: Call: max(price - strike, 0) - premium. Put: max(strike - price, 0) - premium. Before expiry the option's price also depends on time and volatility.
